items.title: Delhi court grants regular bail to Swatantra Bhardwaj in CJP protest assault case
items.summary: A Delhi court on Tuesday granted right-wing influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj regular bail in a case related to the assault of the father of a student-activist during the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protests at Jantar Mantar. Additional Sessions Judge (ASJ) Saurabh Pratap Singh Laler of the Patiala House Court passed the order. The judge had earlier granted him interim bail for three weeks . The Court had then said that it would observe his conduct before considering his plea for regular bail. Bhardwaj was arrested from Uttar Pradesh on September 5 for allegedly assaulting the father of a Dalit student-activist during the CJP protests at Jantar Mantar in July. A separate FIR invoking provisions of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO Act) has also been registered against him. In the first FIR, Bhardwaj was initially booked only for the offences under Sections 115(2) (causing simple hurt) and 126(2) (wrongful restraint) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).
